artifact: 03 - F-6 failure-path classification of every recorded Chewy §6.08 degradation (A-G taxonomy of the mission)

classes.A_MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: the compiler emitted something outside the documented wire contract
classes.B_WIRE_SCHEMA_TOO_NARROW: a valid generic concept rejected unnecessarily by the tolerant wire schema
classes.C_NORMALIZATION_LOSS: wire accepted but normalization drops/mis-types structure
classes.D_IR_SCHEMA_GAP: genuinely not representable in the compositional IR
classes.E_TYPE_CHECKER_DEFECT: representable, but the type checker/validator incorrectly rejects it

perExpression.detail: TRANSACTION_INPUT_REFERENCE 'first public offering ... has been consummated' carried no valueType and was defaulted to MONEY in the IF.condition slot; the IF then failed 'condition must be BOOLEAN' and the enclosing ADD collapsed with it (E).

SUBTRACT(MONEY-tree, model-emitted UNSUPPORTED usage deduction): the type checker returned UNSUPPORTED for the whole and normalization collapsed the composite; the represented left side survived only inside a diagnostic sidecar.

DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE 'Specified Event of Default' under NOT carried no valueType -> MONEY; NOT/AND collapsed; validate.ts then raised TYPE_ERROR 'gatedBy must be BOOLEAN' on an unknown-typed gate -> IR_VALIDATION_FAILURE on the unit.
SUBTRACT(model-emitted UNSUPPORTED pool component, typed usage deduction) collapsed whole.
SUBTRACT(model-emitted UNSUPPORTED pool component, ADD(typed usage deductions)) collapsed whole.

five honestly unsupported addends (three wrapped in MULTIPLY(PERCENT(1), ...)) collapsed the positive ADD, then the outer SUBTRACT; every fully typed component (50% CNI, Retained ECF, EBITDA - 140% interest, MAX($540M, 75% EBITDA), retained proceeds, sale-leaseback proceeds) existed only in nested sidecars.

counts.note: 3 of the 7 have F as the EARLIEST failure and E as the consequence; the other 4 are E outright. Counting by earliest failure: F=3, E=4.

earliestDominantFailureStage: IR type-check / normalization boundary (buildComposite + inferType): 'type unknown' (an untyped reference, or an honest UNSUPPORTED child) was treated as 'type invalid', so the whole composite was discarded. Both F and E are the same conflation seen from two sides.
existingIrSufficiencyEvidence: every after-state expression is expressed with pre-existing kinds only: MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO literals, METRIC_REFERENCE/DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE/TRANSACTION_INPUT_REFERENCE/LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE/RULE_REFERENCE, ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/MAX/MIN/SUM, COMPARE/AND/OR/NOT/IF, UNLIMITED_CAPACITY, IRSharedCapacity + memberRuleIds + dependsOn. No new expression kind was added.
